To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed an attribute-based fine-grained learning and retrieval framework that enables users to query for clothing items based on visual attributes.

(i) we present a fine-grained attribute learning model for clothing style recognition, (ii) we construct a fine-grained clothing style vocabulary, (iii) we propose a clothing style recognition framework that uses the fine-grained vocabulary, and (iv) we demonstrate the potential of the framework by reporting results on a clothing style recognition task.

(1) fine-grained clothing style classification can be achieved by training a linear classifier on a large set of visual attributes, (2) a large number of attributes are required to achieve good performance on clothing style classification, (3) a large number (over 100) of clothing styles can be recognized with high accuracy using a small number of visual attributes, and (4) the fine-grained visual classification model is useful for clothing image retrieval.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: (1) What is a fine-grained clothing style and how to represent it?
the following questions: (1) What are the visual attributes that can be used to describe clothing items?
the following questions: How can we construct a vocabulary of clothing attributes?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents a novel fine-grained clothing attribute recognition and retrieval system.
this paper proposes an attribute vocabulary construction method and a fine-grained clothing recognition system.
this paper presents an attribute-based learning framework for clothing recognition and retrieval, with a focus on fine-grained visual search.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel fine-grained clothing style retrieval system that can be used for mobile applications like image search and image annotation.
we propose a finegrained clothing style learning model and retrieval framework for mobile fashion applications.
we have developed an attribute vocabulary and a fine-grained clothing recognition system that could be used to recognize and retrieve clothing images based on their style.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a finegrained learning model can be used to extract visual attributes that can be used for clothing style recognition and retrieval.
fine-grained visual learning is a promising approach for attribute-based multimedia search and retrieval.
finegrained visual recognition can be achieved with reasonable accuracy on clothing items using a large number of visual attributes.
